summary: Hệ thống tối ưu hóa hiệu suất cho harness AI agents, nâng cao kỹ năng, bộ nhớ, an ninh và phát triển theo hướng nghiên cứu-first cho Claude Code, Codex, Opencode và Cursor.
usecases: Optimizing LLM agent performance for complex code generation tasks
Enhancing security and instinct-based filtering in AI-assisted development pipelines
Research-first development workflow for evaluating and comparing agent capabilities
ideas: Create a benchmarking suite for AI coding agents across different models
Develop a plugin for real-time agent performance monitoring in VS Code
Integrate with CI/CD to automatically optimize agent workflows on pull requests
